resources.string: Docucraft: PDF Scanner & OCR
Scan, organize and find your documents. No watermark, no account, no cloud.

Docucraft turns your paper documents into files you can actually find. Scan an invoice, a contract or your notes, and days later, find them by a word written inside. It all happens right on your phone: no account, no cloud, no watermark.

CLEAN SCANS
The camera detects the edges of the page, crops it and cleans it up for you. Scan several pages into one PDF, from the camera or from photos you already have. The result is a clean PDF with no watermark. It's your document, not ours.

SEARCH BY CONTENT
Docucraft reads the text in your documents, scans included once you turn on text recognition. Search for "rent" or "warranty" and it shows you the exact page where the word appears, with the words around it. Accents and capitals don't get in the way.

ORGANIZE YOUR WAY
Folders inside folders, each with its own color and icon. Tags, favorites, and Recents for what you opened last. Pin the folders you use most to Home, and give your tags sections of their own.

READ AT YOUR LEISURE
The viewer remembers exactly where you left off, down to the line. Select and copy text, print, share or switch to night mode. It also opens the PDFs you receive in other apps.

LINKS WITHOUT SURPRISES
Before a link in a PDF opens, Docucraft shows you where it really leads. A look-alike address can't pass for the real one.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Scanning and text recognition run on your device. Your documents and their text never leave it unless you share them. And if you delete something by mistake, the bin keeps it safe for 30 days.

CRAFTED WITH CARE
A Material You interface with a frosted-glass finish that takes on your phone's colors, made for tablets and foldables too, and designed to make handling documents a pleasure.

FREE AND OPEN
No ads, no subscriptions, no sign-up. Docucraft is open source under the GPL-3.0 license: github.com/BobbyESP/Docucraft
